title: Indonesia Open Justice Observatory (IOJO) — Judicial Transparency & Case Statistics (2024–2025)
subtitle: Reproducible judicial performance indicators and case statistics extracted from Mahkamah Agung RI Annual Reports.
description: Independent research dataset curated by Cecep Mustafa, Ph.D. (IOJO). Contains structured DS02 case statistics and DS06 derived indicators (IND-01 to IND-10) from Kepaniteraan Mahkamah Agung RI Annual Reports (2024-2025) under strict zero-imputation and zero-PII rules. Source PDFs are NOT redistributed.
